exposure: continuation of NTZ into the third trimester
continuous NTZ exposure after the 30th week
cohort: The study included 30 pregnant women with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) who were receiving natalizumab (NTZ).
finding: Continuing natalizumab (NTZ) during pregnancy, including into the third trimester, was generally well tolerated and not associated with major maternal or neonatal complications, although earlier NTZ discontinuation was associated with postpartum relapse and continuous exposure after the 30th week was marginally associated with low birth weight.
gest_age: mean gestational age at delivery of 37.79 ± 1.23 weeks
